coverage: selected primary documents directly supporting the delivered database design, not a claim of exhaustive web coverage

sources.title: PostgreSQL Table Partitioning
supported_claims: Partition pruning depends on partition bounds and query predicates.
Partitioned-table unique/primary constraints must include partition key columns.
Partition count and application workload affect the tradeoff; partitioning is not an unconditional speedup.
sources.read_scope: Overview, declarative partitioning, limitations, pruning and best-practice sections.
limits: No Pulse benchmark was run. Observed current documentation labels itself PostgreSQL 18; prerelease banner is not evidence of a newer stable version.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Transaction Isolation
supported_claims: Read Committed statements may see different committed snapshots within one transaction.
Repeatable Read provides a stable transaction snapshot, and serialization conflicts require application handling.
Sequence increments are visible independently of transaction rollback and cannot establish commit order.
sources.read_scope: Isolation comparison, sequence caveat, Read Committed/Repeatable Read/Serializable behavior.
limits: The source does not prove this project implements correct retry, cursor or multi-store coordination.

sources.title: PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE
supported_claims: Column and table constraints have distinct semantics.
Foreign keys and unique constraints enforce declared relations, not arbitrary JSON payload or PIT meanings.
sources.read_scope: Constraint and partition grammar reference used for schema design.
limits: pglast static parsing is not PostgreSQL execution.

sources.title: ClickHouse MergeTree
supported_claims: MergeTree sorting and sparse index design is workload-dependent.
Primary keys do not impose row uniqueness.
TTL processing is tied to background processing and is not an instantaneous application guarantee.
sources.read_scope: Index, sorting/primary key and TTL sections.
limits: No evidence establishes a universal row-count threshold at which ClickHouse is required.

sources.title: ClickHouse ReplacingMergeTree
supported_claims: Replacement/deduplication occurs through merges and is not immediate uniqueness.
ORDER BY determines duplicate identity; a version column can select a revision.
limits: Query-time consistency must be designed and benchmarked; the engine is not the cash-ledger transaction store.

sources.title: DuckLake Transactions
supported_claims: DuckLake has transactional snapshot semantics for its own catalog/data operations.
limits: This does not grant atomicity with an independent PostgreSQL business transaction or an external API.

sources.title: DuckLake Snapshots
supported_claims: Committed change sets create catalog snapshots.
Snapshots expose ID, commit metadata and optional extra information.
Catalog identity must accompany a snapshot identifier in a multi-catalog application.
sources.read_scope: Snapshot listing, current/last committed snapshot functions and commit-extra-info example.
limits: The final claim about catalog identity is application design inferred from catalog-scoped access, not a cross-catalog global-ID guarantee. Recovery by batch ID must be implemented by Pulse.

sources.title: NATS JetStream pull consumers
supported_claims: Pull consumers support explicitly acknowledged batch fetching and continuously driven pull consumption.
Fetch size, timeout and consumer bounds must be set by application workload.
sources.read_scope: Pull patterns, fetch/consume examples and bounded batch discussion.
limits: This page does not prove end-to-end exactly-once business effects. Database inbox/outbox and side-effect idempotency are Pulse design obligations.

sources.title: Tushare daily
supported_claims: daily vol is in hands and amount is in thousand yuan.
pre_close is described as an ex-rights reference price, and pct_chg is in percent.
Daily raw/unadjusted data and postclose fields have endpoint-specific publication/coverage meanings.
sources.read_scope: Input/output field table, unadjusted/availability notes and postclose optional fields.
limits: No authenticated live call made. Synthetic fixtures validate only the documented conversion and cannot certify real intraday completeness. Postclose inclusion must be verified, never blindly added.

sources.title: Tushare rt_k
supported_claims: rt_k vol is in shares and amount is in yuan, unlike daily.
The endpoint exposes cumulative intraday fields and a trade count; optional trade_time may be absent.
sources.read_scope: Endpoint description, permission note and output fields.
limits: No entitlement or live connection established. A cumulative snapshot is not an independent interval bar.

sources.title: AKShare stock_zh_a_hist
supported_claims: Chinese field 成交量 is in hands and 成交额 in yuan.
The adjust parameter distinguishes raw/forward-adjusted/backward-adjusted outputs.
AKShare documents Eastmoney as this endpoint underlying source.
sources.read_scope: stock_zh_a_hist input/output tables and example under stock quote documentation.
limits: AKShare is an adapter; two Eastmoney-derived paths are not independent original market observations. Synthetic examples do not imply service availability or authorization.

sources.title: OpenAPI Specification directory
supported_claims: The official specification has multiple published versions; a contract must select an explicit supported version.
limits: The directory alone does not validate a selected TypeScript/Python generator or semantic compatibility. Pulse must lock and test its actual toolchain.

sources.title: Apache Arrow Columnar Format
supported_claims: Arrow defines a language-independent typed columnar representation, including decimal and timestamp types.
limits: Arrow is not a data-quality or transaction coordinator; no zero-copy guarantee is claimed for every transport/driver.

sources.title: DuckLake Conflict Resolution
supported_claims: Concurrent metadata/data operations can require retries or conflict handling rather than unconditional success.
limits: Pulse retry policy, idempotency and exact compatible extension versions remain implementation work.
